signature.name: VTask.orElse
signature.type: {α : Type u} -> (c₁ : Computation α) -> (c₂ : Unit → Computation α) -> Computation α

conventions.statement: The `Unit →` wrapper on `c₂` is a typeclass artifact; `c₂ ()` is evaluated at the moment `orElse` is called, so both computations run from step one.
conventions.note: Reflects the OrElse typeclass convention; no actual laziness.

conventions.statement: If both `c₁` and `c₂` produce a value in the same round, the value from `c₁` is returned.
conventions.note: Follows from the left-biased pattern match in the step function.

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (a : α) (c₂ : Unit → Computation α), VTask.orElse (pure a) c₂ = pure a

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (c : Computation α), VTask.orElse (Computation.empty α) (fun _ => c) = c

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (c : Computation α), VTask.orElse c (fun _ => Computation.empty α) = c

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (c₁ c₂ : Computation α), VTask.orElse (Computation.think c₁) (fun _ => Computation.think c₂) = Computation.think (VTask.orElse c₁ (fun _ => c₂))

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; unvalidated by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (c₁ : Computation α) (a : α), VTask.orElse (Computation.think c₁) (fun _ => pure a) = pure a

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (a b : α), a ≠ b → VTask.orElse (pure a) (fun _ => pure b) ≠ pure b

facts.statement: ∃ (a b : ℕ), VTask.orElse (Computation.pure a) (fun _ => Computation.pure b) ≠ VTask.orElse (Computation.pure b) (fun _ => Computation.pure a)
